Subject: Re: MAP / evaluation timeline request

Hi Avery —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our leadership liked the product trajectory and wants a short, executable mutual action plan we can share with procurement and our platform team. Two asks: 1) can you share a template MAP (GSlides preferred) we can use as the single source of truth; and 2) what does a typical 6–8 week close path look like for a deployment like ours (pilot -> production)?

Key constraints:
- SOC2 documentation review needs to happen during week 1–2.
- We need an evaluation rubric for latency and inference cost per 1M tokens.
- Procurement expects an initial PO by the end of November (we're in the US west coast).

Looping Tom (engineering lead) for technical questions. Can you also flag any data residency or VPC steps that typically slow procurement?

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Kim
Head of Platform Programs
Pegasus AI

Subject: Draft: Path-to-Prod MAP & Close Timeline (GSlides + GDoc)

Hi Sara / Tom —

Appreciate the clarity. I've attached a lightweight MAP slide deck and a companion GDoc checklist that we use as the single source for milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria. Both are intentionally modular so we can hand over the evaluation rubric and SOC2 evidence matrix into your procurement folder.

Attachments (stubs):
- path-to-prod-map-v1.gslides (application/vnd.google-apps.presentation) — slide-based MAP with milestones and owner swimlanes
- path-to-prod-map-v1.gdoc (application/vnd.google-apps.document) — checklist with acceptance criteria and suggested test prompts

Quick proposed 6-week runway (high level):
1) Week 1: Kickoff + SOC2 evidence queue + assign stakeholders (legal, infra, data)
2) Week 2: Controlled pilot setup (VPC peering / keys) + baseline eval (latency & cost)
3) Week 3: Feature validation + security deep-dive (we provide an evidence pack)
4) Week 4: Expanded pilot (scale tests / QA) + cost tuning recommendations
5) Week 5: Procurement negotiations / PO prep (pricing bands attached in doc)
6) Week 6: Signoff & plan for production rollout (canary strategy)

Next steps I suggest: pick a 90-minute technical kickoff (we do a focused MAP workshop) and we will run the MAP live and update the slides in real time. Are mornings (10–12 PDT) this coming week okay?

Link to working slide deck (view): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1PtP-map-slide
Link to working checklist (edit): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1PtP-map-doc

I'll also tag the legal and security playbooks for SOC2 artifacts in the doc.

—Avery

Avery —

Nice first pass. A couple of suggested edits before we share externally:
- Slide 3 (acceptance criteria): add explicit latency SLOs for 95th and 99th percentile and a token-cost bucket for 100K/1M volumes.
- GDoc section: include a single-table evidence list (SOC2, network diagrams, retention policy) with a point person from our security team.
- Pricing: rather than fixed numbers in the MAP, include pricing bands and a clear reserved capacity offer (Dedicated) as an option.

I'll add inline comments to the GDoc (link below). Assigning Karthik to review the VPC steps — he can confirm typical network artifacts for a west-coast AWS account.
